title: tab/dialogClosed
description: Engine-to-shell notification: a dialog or permission prompt is no longer waiting: it was answered (by tab/dialogAnswer), or the engine closed it because the tab navigated, closed or reset its dialogs (CefJSDialogHandler::OnResetDialogState, CefPermissionHandler::OnDismissPermissionPrompt). The shell closes its dialog if it still shows it.

tab.description: The tab's id, as tab/create answered it ("1", "2", ...; never reused in one engine process).

accepted.description: How it ended, when it was answered.
